components.name: Instrument
components.description: Room control on the rail (SOUND, AUTO-DEVELOP).
components.css: .ds-instrument { font: 600 0.72rem/1.4 Archivo, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #ff3b2a; background: none; border: 1px solid #7a1408; padding: 7px 11px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-instrument span { color: #9a938a; } .ds-instrument:hover { background: rgba(122,20,8,0.3); } .ds-instrument:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff3b2a; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Stamp Link
components.description: Rubber-stamped link on the paper-white verso.

components.name: Fix Stamp
components.description: Appears on a developed print; fixing makes it permanent across visits.

components.name: Hint Stamp
components.description: Dashed imperative instruction stamped over the room or a print.
components.css: .ds-hint { font: 700 0.78rem/1.4 Archivo, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.18em; color: #ff3b2a; border: 1px dashed #7a1408; padding: 10px 14px; background: rgba(6,4,3,0.62); display: inline-block; }

narrative.northStar: The Print That Doesn't Exist Yet
narrative.overview: A photographic darkroom after midnight. Content condenses out of living film grain under the visitor's held attention. The ROOM is drenched safelight red on near-black; the PRINTS are silver-gelatin grayscale on paper white and carry all sustained reading.
keyCharacteristics: Film grain everywhere, never decorative — the substrate images come from
Interaction is photochemistry: expose, agitate, develop, dodge/burn, fix
Darkness is physical: white light fogs unfixed prints
Content authored as photographic artifacts: prints, contact sheets, stamps, grease pencil

rules.name: The Two Rooms Rule
rules.body: Red belongs to the room; grayscale belongs to prints. Sustained reading happens only on prints.

rules.name: The Fog Rule
rules.body: Pure white appears exactly once — the white-light pull cord — and it is a catastrophe, not a highlight.

rules.name: The Stamp Rule
rules.body: Uppercase tracked labels are stamped: bordered or underlined, short, imperative.

dos: Do render all content as photographic artifacts with grain participating
Do make development progress visible within ~300ms of holding
Do keep escape hatches: AUTO-DEVELOP, reduced-motion, keyboard develop
Do keep the room dark in every fallback
donts: Don't put paragraphs in red or on raw room ground
Don't use box-shadows, radii, gradient buttons, or stock chrome
Don't reveal content by cursor-position flashlight
Don't fabricate bio facts — placeholders ship in-world as AWAITING EXPOSURE
